body.name: probability-compatible benefit root
body.construction: For \(p_0=(q_0-u)/(v-u)\), \(p_1=(q_1-u)/(v-u)\), \(\Delta=p_1-p_0\), \(r=\theta-1\), \(B=1-r\Delta\), and \(C=p_1(1-p_0)\), define \[b_{\theta}(u,v)=\begin{cases}C,&\theta=1,\\(-B+\sqrt{B^2+4rC})/(2r),&\theta\ne1.\end{cases}\] The second branch is evaluated by its algebraically equivalent stable form when cancellation would occur.
